top_signals.title: Bond Traders Are Hedging Risk Fed Pivots to Rate Cuts in 2027
top_signals.summary: Bond traders are changing gears again. After a raft of data helped all but price out interest rate hikes for the rest of the year, wagers in the options market are looking to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve pivots to cutting rates in 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Consumer demand fires strong July for LA port
